mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers bearish market sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates combined with rising unemployment rates create conflicting signals but result in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to market uncertainty.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average and UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Both quarterly billings (GDPC1) and monthly sales (RSAFS) exceeding their 5-month moving averages signal robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are above their 5-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly billings (GDPC1) below 2% growth in a late-cycle expansion regime triggers a correction in equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth falls below 2% in the late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates paired with strong industrial production (INDPRO) growth indicate accommodative monetary policy and robust supply, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average and INDPRO is above its 5-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: The Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) crossing above 200 signals high inflation, triggering bearish market sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 200 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) combined with falling employment figures (PAYEMS) signal weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is falling.
